summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) using the second item of the control code; CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests were added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was committed and no tests or mypy were run, per instructions, so the test results and strict-mypy check on the widened ControlCode union remain unverified.
